description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Dark, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Dark with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] after using a Dark/Poison ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kefka
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Cruelest Angel (0~2), removed after using Cruelest Angel two times

description.name: Cruelest Angel Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Cruelest Angel level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kefka]

description.name: Cruelest Angel Level
description.text: Keeps track of Cruelest Angel level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kefka]
